changeover_table.label: Changeover matrix by family
changeover_table.help: matrix[from][to] in minutes; null means forbidden. same_family and same_family_other_color in minutes.

changeover_override.label: One changeover time that replaces the matrix
changeover_override.help: minutes; match on from_product/to_product, or from_family/to_family; optional line or lines. The most specific rule wins.

forbidden_transition.label: A family may never follow another
forbidden_transition.help: from_family/to_family or from_product/to_product; optional line or lines.

line_capability.label: A family runs only on some lines
line_capability.help: family or product_code, and the lines that can run it.

customer_line_qualification.label: A customer is supplied only from some lines
customer_line_qualification.help: customer (exact SAP name), lines, optional family.

shared_resource_gap.label: Two starts on lines sharing a resource must be apart
shared_resource_gap.help: family, lines sharing the resource, gap_minutes between two starts.

max_changeovers_per_shift.label: Maximum changeovers per line per shift
max_changeovers_per_shift.help: max; optional line or lines, shifts (A, B, C), weekdays (0 Sunday to 6 Saturday). The lowest applicable maximum applies.

transition_window.label: A changeover may start only in a time window
transition_window.help: from_family/to_family or products, optional line, weekdays, from and to as HH:MM. If several rules match, any of their windows is allowed.

blackout.label: A line, or a family on a line, cannot run in a window
blackout.help: line or lines, optional family; either weekdays with from and to (HH:MM, to may be past midnight), or start and end as dates.

rate_factor.label: A line runs slower or faster on some days
rate_factor.help: factor applied to 2.02 t/h; optional line or lines, family or product_code, weekdays. Factors multiply.

release_lag.label: Time between the end of production and shipping
release_lag.help: minutes and kind (lab, transport, packing, buffer); filter by customer, product_code or family. The longest of a kind applies; kinds add up.

priority.label: Weights of customers when something must be late
priority.help: weights by customer name; default for the others.

freeze_window.label: How far ahead nothing moves
freeze_window.help: minutes from now; the running order and the next ones inside the window keep their place.

line_preference.label: Soft: an order prefers some lines
line_preference.help: lines and penalty (cost units; one changeover minute costs 1); filter by family, customer, product_code, min_tonnes, max_tonnes. Never forbids a line.
